backup.title: Backup
backup.explain: Your data lives only on this phone. Export a backup every now and then: it's the only way not to lose everything if the phone breaks or you switch it.
backup.never_exported: You haven't exported a backup yet
backup.invalid_file: This file isn't a valid backup
backup.confirm_warning: Your current data will be replaced with the file's. This can't be undone.
backup.csv_explain: To open your data in a spreadsheet: diary, weight, steps and workouts, one after another in a single file. Different from the backup, which is meant to restore.
backup.explain_signed_in: Your data is already copied to the server, so a broken phone won't take it with it. The backup is still useful for two things: progress photos, which never leave this phone, and having your data in a file of your own.

social.title: Friends
social.account_intro: With an account your data is copied to the server, so a broken phone won't take it with it and you'll find it again on a second device. Nothing else reaches other users: they only see the daily totals you choose to share.
social.handle_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. Friends find you by this.
social.no_friends: No friends yet. Search by username above.
social.shares_hint: Everything starts off. Turn on only what you want to show.
social.sign_out_message: Your data stays on the phone. You're only signing out of this device.
social.not_friend_yet: Become friends to see what they share.
social.no_backend: The friends section needs a server. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL to enable it.
social.share_gym_hint: Turning it on, friends see which exercises you do and with what load, not just how often you train. Off, nothing about the gym goes out.
social.compare_limit: Up to four people: five columns of numbers don't fit on a phone.
social.compare_empty: Choose at least one friend to compare with your numbers.
social.compare_no_gym: None of you share the gym for this day.
social.compare_period_hint: Over several days, steps and workouts add up, calories are the average of the logged days.
